thread:
lina: During the quarterly access review I found 22 principals indirectly getting KMS:Decrypt via group inheritance (team-ops -> infra-admins). This bypasses ownerproof.

marcus: ouch. group inheritance often slips by the sweeper. do you have the query?

lina:```sql
SELECT member, binding_source, role
FROM iam_bindings_snapshot
WHERE role LIKE '%KMS%' AND binding_source LIKE '%group%';
```

anya: i see two problem patterns: 1) groups created by onboarding with wide membership 2) infra modules that bind groups instead of service accounts.

sec-bot: [automated] Policy drift detection PD-2026-450: Group-based KMS bindings detected. Risk: elevated.

ingest-bot: note: we also have a 3h hole in audit ingestion on 2026-03-02 00:30-03:30 UTC for shard-7 due to an index rebuild. some decrypt events may not be present.

marcus: that ingestion gap could affect ownerproof for a subset of these principals. we need two parallel tracks: backfill logs + require manual attest for group-derived grants.

lina: agree. i'm hesistant to autoremove anyone until we confirm evidence. propose we: (A) pause auto-prune for groups touching `sensitive:kms` (B) kick off a replay for shard-7 (C) run a scan that expands ownerproof to include group membership owners.

peter: on (C) we should be careful: group owners are often team leads; we'll need org mapping. i can add a join to `org.groups` to fetch owners and last_activity.

vendor-ops: pinged vendors for any SAs in the set. some vendor SAs were added by vendor onboarding and listed the integrator as owner, but no PR evidence.

marcus: starting replay job: rp-20260302-07 queued. ingest-bot will report status.

ingest-bot: rp-20260302-07 running. estimated 2h. note: replay may not include ephemeral logs if retention archived.

lina: temporary mitigation ideas: 1) add a gate in entitlement-sweeper that treats `binding_type=group` and `resource=sensitive:kms` as manual review 2) for group members, mark `owner_required=true` if group age > 30d and member count > 5.

anya: I'll open a PR for the sweeper gate. will also add telemetry metric `entitlement.group_bindings_blocked`.

sec-bot: incident created INC-2026-451 "Group-based KMS bindings and missing audit evidence" assigned to eng-security. Priority: P3.

marcus: replay finished rp-20260302-07 status=success files=2,340 bytes=2.1GB. ownerproof collector re-run: cr-20260302-09 found 14 recovered proofs.

lina: that helps. remaining 8 principals still without evidence: 5 are group members (no explicit owner), 2 vendor SAs, 1 human contractor.

peter: for groups, i suggest auto-filling owner proof with group owner email if owner has last_activity < 180d, otherwise require manual attestation. will add to collector.

anya: PR #1024 opened to add sweeper gate and collector augmentation. reviewers: lina, marcus.

vendor-ops: vendor attestation received for 1 SA; second vendor needs legal sign-off.

lina: remediation checklist: 1) update entitlement-sweeper (anya) 2) augment collector to include group-owner fallback (peter) 3) vendor attestation follow-up (vendor-ops) 4) manual JIT path for contractor (marcus).

sec-bot: compliance note: SOC2 audit will require documentation of ownerproof fallback logic. add to INC-2026-451.

marcus: setting a short-term rule: any group binding to KMS must have an explicit `group_owner` tag in `org.groups` or it will be rejected by the iam-onboard bot. opening INFRA ticket.

lina: thanks. i'll update the access-review tracker and pause auto-removals for these principals until proofs are recovered or attestations complete. reconvene tomorrow for sign-off.

peter: also adding a follow-up to correlation logic: map group membership join-times to grant times to avoid accidental retroactive owner assignment.

lina: good call. leaving thread open for incident updates. :thumbsup:
